name: RISE! Servitors of Nuclear Fusion
source:
The colony's task was simple: shift the planet to a different orbit. Move the barren world closer to the star and turn it into a blooming garden. It's easy when you have tools of the appropriate size. A job just right for the Wirion Space corporation.

But when you live on a megastructure engine, any problems also get the "mega" prefix. As a result of a disaster, the gigantic device was destroyed. Having lost their purpose of existence, the colonists turned to a familiar human pastime - an internecine war for resources.

The war quietly burned out, bringing victory to neither side. Lev Aminin, once a simple combat mech pilot, is now forced to head to the camp of his former enemies as a symbol of a new, peaceful coexistence. But being a symbol isn't easy when your new colleagues still see you as an enemy, and the ghosts of the past won't let you go either. The situation is not helped by the planet's nascent biosphere, which is already striving to destroy all traces of the ill-fated colony.

[From [url=https://vk.ru/wall-182189857_4599]VK[/url]]
translation:
殖民地的任务原本十分简单：改变这颗行星的公转轨道，将这片荒芜的世界推向恒星，令其化作繁花似锦的花园。只要拥有足够庞大的工具，这一切便易如反掌——对于维里昂航天公司而言，这正是再合适不过的差事。

可当你生活在一座巨构引擎之上时，任何麻烦也都会冠上“巨型”的前缀。一场灾难降临，这座庞然大物轰然损毁。失去了存在意义的殖民者们，很快重拾了人类最熟悉的消遣——一场为争夺资源而爆发的自相残杀。

战火悄然燃尽，双方皆未赢得胜利。曾是一名普通战斗机甲驾驶员的列夫·阿米宁，如今不得不作为和平共处新时代的象征，动身前往昔日宿敌的营地。然而，当新同僚依旧将你视作仇寇、过去的亡灵也迟迟不肯放过你时，充当“和平象征”绝非易事；更糟糕的是，这颗行星初生的生物圈已然蠢蠢欲动，誓要抹去这座厄运殖民地留下的全部痕迹。
